document.title: VectorLoom Basic Vector Library Format
document.purpose: Describe the initial, small VectorLoom JSON format for a library of styled vector designs.
author: Lion Kimbro
Codex (GPT-5)

orientation.summary: A VectorLoom Basic document is a reusable vector library. It defines named styles and named designs; it does not itself choose a root design or a scene to render.
scope: Supported primitives are line, rect, oval, polyline, and text.
Groups are non-rendering nested elements with a local position and rotation.
Connector points are non-rendering named local coordinate frames for attachment and port semantics.
Styles are reusable named drawing-property objects.
Designs are reusable named structures, each expressed in its own local coordinate system. A design may be a visible drawing or a structural or spatial mechanism.
not-yet-in-scope: a document root or top-level drawing contents

format-guide.document-shape: The format has two top-level sections: styles and designs. Other top-level fields are not part of VectorLoom Basic at this time.
format-guide.styles: An object mapping style names to style objects. A shape may refer to a named style with its style field.
format-guide.designs: An object mapping design names to design objects. Each design represents one reusable named structure.
format-guide.design: A design object has a contents array. Its items are elements in that design's local coordinate system. The list order is drawing order for rendered shapes: later rendered shapes are drawn over earlier shapes.
format-guide.group: A group is a non-rendering element with x, y, angle, and contents. Its position and angle are relative to its parent group or, at top level, its containing design. Its contents use the group's local coordinate system.
format-guide.connector-point: A connector point is a non-rendering named local coordinate frame with x, y, angle, role, and optional tags. Its resolved position and orientation are derived through the transforms of its parent groups. Connector ids are unique within their containing design.
format-guide.transform-convention: For a group local point, rotate around the group's local origin, then translate by its x and y position: parent_point = Translate(x, y) × Rotate(angle) × local_point. The x and y position places the local origin in the parent coordinate system; rotation does not rotate that translation vector around the parent origin.
format-guide.element-identity: A shape or group may have an id. The uniqueness scope of these optional element ids is not yet decided. A connector point must have an id, unique within its containing design. Shapes, groups, and connector points may have tags: an optional list of semantic labels.
format-guide.canvas-item-identification: When a runtime realizes a primitive as a Tkinter Canvas item, the design key, optional shape id, and primitive tags can be preserved as Canvas tags. The render-time Canvas tag contract is described in pseudo-src/vectorloom/aspects/canvas-item-identification.md. A caller-supplied placement instance is runtime data, not a VectorLoom Basic document field.
format-guide.coordinates: Coordinates are abstract document units. Rect and oval use x, y, w, and h, where x and y are the top-left corner of the bounding box. Line uses x1, y1, x2, and y2. Polyline uses points as [x, y] pairs. Text uses x and y as its anchor point.
format-guide.text-layout: Text follows Tkinter Canvas text capabilities. anchor selects which of the text item's nine compass positions lies at x, y: n, ne, e, se, s, sw, w, nw, or center. It defaults to center. Font, wrapping width, wrapped-line justification, and angle may also be specified. Angles are in degrees; positive values rotate clockwise. Anchor placement is relative to the text item's bounding area; typographic-baseline placement is not part of this format.
format-guide.style-resolution: For now, style is a named reference only. Inline styles, style inheritance, and shape-level style overrides are deliberately unspecified.

style-name.description: A name used as a key in styles and as a shape's style reference.

design-name.description: A name used as a key in designs.

element-id.description: An element identifier. It is optional unless an element schema requires it; the uniqueness scope of optional element ids is not yet decided.

element-tag.description: One semantic label declared on an element.

element-tags.description: Optional semantic labels declared on an element.

vocabulary.attachment: A connector intended as an attachment point.
vocabulary.port: A connector intended as a port.

connector-role.description: The semantic role of a connector point.

text-anchor.description: The part of a text item's bounding area positioned at x, y.

tk-font-spec.description: A Tk font name or a JSON representation of a Tk font descriptor, such as ["TkDefaultFont", 12, "bold"].

stroke.description: Stroke color, or null for no stroke.

fill.description: Fill color, or null for no fill.

dash.description: Optional dash pattern, such as the string '6 4'.

vector-shape.description: One supported VectorLoom Basic primitive shape.

vector-element.description: A primitive shape, non-rendering group, or non-rendering connector point in a design or group contents array.

font.description: Defaults to Tk's normal canvas font.

width.description: Optional maximum line width for wrapping text at word boundaries.

justify.description: Alignment of wrapped lines; defaults to left.

angle.description: Clockwise rotation in degrees around the anchor point; defaults to 0.

vector-design.title: Vector Design
vector-design.description: A named reusable structure. Its contents use coordinates local to this design.

group.title: Group
group.description: A non-rendering nested element that establishes a local coordinate system for its contents.

x.description: Parent-relative x position of the group's local origin; defaults to 0.

y.description: Parent-relative y position of the group's local origin; defaults to 0.

angle.description: Clockwise rotation in degrees around the group's local origin; defaults to 0.

contents.description: Elements in drawing order, in the group's local coordinate system.

connector-point.title: Connector Point
connector-point.description: A non-rendering named local coordinate frame for attachment or port semantics.

id.description: A connector identifier unique within the containing design.

angle.description: Clockwise rotation in degrees; defaults to 0.
